## Notes

<!-- Unusual findings: monorepo layout, path aliases, barrel re-exports,
     excluded test/vendor dirs, language-specific caveats. -->

**Stack & manifest**
- Single manifest: root `package.json` (all app sources are TypeScript `.ts`/`.tsx`). No other stack manifest (composer.json, Gemfile, pyproject.toml, pom.xml, build.gradle, go.mod, Cargo.toml) exists outside `node_modules/` → no `[MULTI_STACK]`.
- Next.js 16.4.5 App Router, React 19.3, next-intl 4, @supabase/ssr + supabase-js (Auth, Realtime, Storage), Drizzle ORM 0.45 over postgres-js, zod 4. Resolved stack-profile: `web-js-ts` (`screen_source: route-view`, `detected_language_heading: JS/TS`).
- `next.config.ts`: `experimental.authInterrupts` (enables `forbidden()` → `app/forbidden.tsx`), `cacheComponents`, `partialPrefetching`, next-intl plugin wired to `shared/i18n/request.ts`; validates server env at boot (`parseServerEnv`).
- Path alias: `@/*` → `./*` (tsconfig.json). No barrel re-exports except `shared/db/schema/index.ts` (Drizzle schema barrel, also the drizzle-kit `schema` entry).
- Next 16 renames middleware to **`proxy.ts`** (root). It delegates to `shared/auth/session-proxy.ts` (`runSessionProxy`): (2) refresh + validate Supabase session, (3) public allowlist, (4) guest → `/login?next=` (API → 401 JSON), (4b) non-admin on `/admin/*` → 403 access-denied page / JSON 403, (5) prelaunch gate (`features/awards-portal/server/prelaunch-gate-step.ts`). Matcher excludes `_next/static`, `_next/image`, `images/`, `fonts/`, favicon/robots/sitemap.

**Type-tag conventions used in File Inventory (read before Wave 2 / Wave 7)**
- `screen` (18) = every `app/**/page.tsx` (route-view screens). `app/admin/page.tsx` is redirect-only (→ `/admin/overview`). Route groups `(app)` (signed-in Sunner area, guarded by `requireSunner()` in its layout) and `(public)` (`/login`, `/countdown`) do not appear in URLs.
- `screen-embedded` (178) = non-standalone visual units: all `features/*/components/*.tsx` React components (incl. the `*-screen.tsx` bodies that admin pages render) plus App Router state fallbacks `loading.tsx` / `error.tsx` / `not-found.tsx` / `app/forbidden.tsx`. Not counted as top-level screens.
- `route` (36) = 20 Route Handlers (`app/api/**/route.ts` ×19 + `app/auth/callback/route.ts`), 4 `layout.tsx` route-segment frames (`app/layout.tsx`, `(app)`, `(public)`, `admin`; the `(app)` and `admin` layouts call `requireSunner()` / `requireShellAdmin()`), 11 Server Action modules (`"use server"`, invoked as POSTs to the page path — treat as RPC endpoints for route-list/api-map), and `shared/ui/app-routes.ts` (typed `APP_ROUTES` path map).
- `model` (78) = persistence: 9 Drizzle schema files in `shared/db/schema/` + 38 SQL migrations in `db/migrations/` (24 up `0000`–`0023`, 14 hand-written `.down.sql` for `0010`–`0023`); non-persisted contracts: 30 zod/view-type files in `features/*/schemas/` + `shared/events/domain-event-types.ts` (outbox event contract). Data-model entities (tables) come from the Drizzle schema + SQL only; `features/*/schemas/*` are input-validation / DTO / view shapes (no tables).
- `permission` (21) = proxy + `shared/auth/*` guards (admin-guard `requireAdmin`/`resolveAdminAccess`, current-user `requireSunner`/`getSessionUser`, route-access-policy, public-paths, safe-next-path, access-denied-response, session-profile-query, supabase-server-client) + per-feature API gates (`requireAdminApi`, `requireApiSunner`, `requireNotificationUser`, `requireSecretBoxUser`), cron secret guards (`internal-job-guard.ts`, `outbox-drain-guard.ts`, SHA-256 + `timingSafeEqual`), prelaunch gate, `shell-session.ts` (`requireShellAdmin`), `env-admin-email.ts` (ADMIN_EMAILS rule), `complete-login.ts` (post-OAuth domain check + admin promotion).
- `background` (10) = the three Secret Box jobs, the outbox consumer + its 4 exclusive helpers, and the two Realtime channel hooks.
- `config` (46) = `shared/config/*` (zod env schemas, `event-window.ts` write-window rule), feature `*-config.ts` constants, `kudo-authoring-limits.ts`, `hero-tier-constants.ts`, `shared/i18n/{locales,request}.ts`, `messages/{en,vi}.json` (all UI copy; default locale `vi`, cookie `NEXT_LOCALE` → Accept-Language → `vi`), `next.config.ts`, `drizzle.config.ts`, `supabase/config.toml`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, and 25 drizzle-kit generated files under `db/migrations/meta/` (24 `*_snapshot.json` + `_journal.json`; machine-generated, document only via the journal).
- `other` (168) = server queries/services/repositories (`features/*/server/*` not listed above), client hooks/stores/styles (`*.ts` under `components/`, `hooks/`, `lib/`), markdown parser (`features/kudos-feed/markdown/`), seeds (`db/seeds/*`), `shared/admin/*` CSV/date helpers, `shared/db/client.ts` (Drizzle server-role pool, bypasses RLS), `shared/db/supabase-service-client.ts`, `shared/auth/supabase-browser-client.ts`, `app/globals.css` (Tailwind v4 theme tokens).

**Background-logic architecture (for Wave 2b)**
- Transactional outbox: producers call `shared/events/domain-event-outbox.ts` (`add(tx, type, payload)`, zod-validated, inside the business transaction) from `create-kudo-action.ts`, `kudo-heart-service.ts`, `kudo-moderation-service.ts`, `secret-box-grant-service.ts`, `icon-collection-service.ts`, `national-kudos-finalize-job.ts`. Event types: `KudoCreated`, `HeartAdded`, `KudoMarkedSpam`, `BoxGranted`, `SetCompleted`, `NationalKudosFinalized`. The producer helper is tagged `other` (no canonical BL type for a producer); document it inside the queue-worker BL entry.
- Scheduling lives in Postgres: pg_cron + pg_net POST to `/api/internal/*` with secrets from Supabase Vault; migrations no-op with a NOTICE where pg_cron/pg_net/Vault are missing (host-cron fallback documented in SQL comments). No Node-side scheduler, queue library, or mailer exists.
- Realtime push leg: DB triggers (`0017`, `0019`) → private Broadcast topics `spotlight` and `notifications:{userId}` → client hooks. In-tab fan-out between bell/panel/page uses a window `CustomEvent` (`features/notifications/lib/notification-sync-events.ts`, `hooks/use-notification-sync.ts`) — UI glue, deliberately not inventoried as BL.
- Client timers (toasts, debounced search, `use-minute-clock`, `use-server-clock-now`, `spotlight-resync-scheduler.ts`) are UI behaviour, not BL.
- File-exchange signal: admin CSV exports (`app/api/admin/{kudos,overview,users}/export/route.ts`) are request-driven route handlers, not BL; column contracts live in `features/admin-overview/server/overview-export-columns.ts`, `features/admin-users/server/user-export-columns.ts`, `features/admin-moderation/server/admin-kudo-export.ts`, serializer `shared/admin/csv-serializer.ts`, cap `shared/admin/export-limit.ts`.

**Permission-relevant files tagged elsewhere** (Wave 2 permissions researcher should read them too)
- `features/kudos-feed/components/kudo-card-can-edit.ts` (owner-edit visibility rule), `features/kudos-feed/server/kudo-row-mask.ts` (anonymous-sender masking), `features/admin-users/server/user-role-service.ts` (sole writer of `profiles.role`, last-admin protection, role audit columns), `shared/config/event-window.ts` + `features/kudos-authoring/server/kudo-write-window.ts` (time-window write gate), SQL RLS in `db/migrations/0002_rls_baseline.sql` and later migrations, auth triggers/hook in `0005_auth_user_triggers.sql`.

**Excluded from the inventory**
- Tests and tooling: `tests/`, `test-results/`, `playwright*.config.ts`, `vitest.config.mts`, `eslint.config.mjs`, `scripts/typecheck.mjs`; no `__tests__/` or `*.test|spec.ts(x)` exist under the scanned source roots.
- Vendor/build/workflow dirs: `node_modules/`, `.next/`, `plans/`, `docs/`, `.claude/`, `resources/` (.vsix binary), `public/` (static images/fonts served under `/images`, `/fonts`; asset-only).
- Non-source assets inside scanned roots: `app/favicon.ico`, `features/awards-portal/fonts/DSEG7Classic-Regular.woff2` + `DSEG-LICENSE.txt` (countdown digit font).
- Supabase CLI local state: `supabase/.branches/`, `supabase/.temp/` (contains a generated local edge-runtime env file — not read), `supabase/.gitignore`. `supabase/migrations/` is intentionally empty (drizzle-kit owns the single journal in `db/migrations/`).
- Secrets/generated: `.env`, `.env.local`, `.env.example` (not read; the env contract is `shared/config/env-schema.ts` + `public-env-schema.ts`), `next-env.d.ts`, `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo`, `package-lock.json`, `release-manifest.json`.

**Unclassified / judgement calls**
- No file was left unclassified. Judgement calls: components → `screen-embedded` (template legend has no `component` tag); Server Action modules → `route`; feature zod schemas → `model` (legend's "schema files") although they are not tables; layouts → `route`. Downstream counters that only recognise the base 7 tags (`estimate_artifact_loc.py`) will not count the 178 `screen-embedded` lines in totals — harmless here (36 route files, so the monolithic-route floor never fires).
